name: Lithuania: Part II package and CTIS upload check
applies_to: the Lithuania package as a whole (plan-level checklist step)

sections.title: Completeness against requirements.json (Lithuanian national Part II list)

items.check: K1 recruitment and informed consent procedure present, on EU template v2.0 or an equivalent format, with a section for every population pathway in the plan.
K2 recruitment material present for every recruitment item, with the supporting explanation in K1.
One L1 information and consent set per population and decision-maker in population_sets whose trigger is true.
L2 other information material present only where it is part of the pre-participation information required by Annex I.
List of Lithuanian sites with principal investigator, position and expected number of participants.
Investigator qualification description with the sponsor compliance statement and the E6(R3)/GCP training evidence.
For every Lithuanian site: M1 current CV, M2 signed declaration of interest, N1 signed site suitability statement.
O1 civil liability insurance certificate or policy, or other proof of indemnification, matching the Lithuanian trial.
P1 participant reimbursement description.
P2 trial financing and financial arrangements.
Proof of payment of the Lithuanian state fee.
GDPR compliance statement.
S1 biological-sample compliance information.
Every document of the national list is in Lithuanian.
Signed at submission: each principal investigator's declaration of interest and each site suitability statement (head of institution or delegate).
Other institution or sponsor forms signed only where the applicable form or legal requirement calls for it.
No participant-signed consent form in the dossier; participant documents are blank versions with signature blocks.
Reimbursement and compensation identical in P1, P2 and every participant document.
Insurance or indemnification described in every participant document matches O1.
Sample types, storage, transfers, retention and future use identical in S1, the protocol, the participant information and any future-use consent.
Data flows, recipients, transfers and retention identical in the GDPR statement, the participant documents and the protocol.
Consent pathways in K1 match the L1 sets in the package.
Sites and principal investigators identical in the site list, CTIS, M1, M2, N1 and the qualification description.
Documents adapted from the reference package contain all Lithuanian national additions and no leftovers from the reference country.
items.applies_when: Lithuania is not the reference package

items.check: Correct B–S section prefix and CTIS placeholder for each document; proof of payment in the CTIS proof-of-payment location.
Unique, self-explanatory title of at most 100 characters: <section code>_<document type>_<subtype>_<country>_<language>_<special attribute>, with only the fields that distinguish the document.
Version and date entered in CTIS metadata, not in the title.
Personal names only where disclosure permits (principal investigator in M1/M2).
Clean, tracked-change, redacted or public and split-file variants clearly distinguished.
Uploaded filename base contains none of ( ) / , . ; | [ ] (the period before the extension is fine).
Article 11 workaround: every mandatory Part II placeholder holds the official placeholder PDF titled Part_II_placeholder_document_Article_11_workaround.
items.applies_when: Lithuania receives Part I only under Article 11

items.check: For each document, publication status checked against the current Annex I publication tables (revised rules applicable from 18 June 2024; ACT EU guidance v2.2, 30 April 2026).
Publishable documents: personal data and CCI identified separately; public version redacts only qualifying material, irreversibly; author metadata removed; signatures (M2, N1) never disclosed.
Public and assessment versions differ only by the intended redactions; each in the correct CTIS slot.
No personal data or CCI in public structured fields.
No drafting instruction remains in any document (see content/conventions/template-instructions.md).
Every document approved by the owner in TrialAgents, or the user has explicitly chosen to export unapproved versions.
